title: netbox-email plugin
description: Native NetBox SoT for email infrastructure — mail domains (+ DKIM identity), mailboxes, aliases/forwarding maps, and forwarding relays/smarthosts. Composes netbox-services (MailDomain/MailRelay FK ServiceInstance; references HAMirror). Baseline scaffold + full spec is committed and py_compile-clean; the items below are the deep work owed against a live NetBox.

phases.title: Live-NetBox verification
phases.exit_criteria: makemigrations --check --dry-run reports no changes and the full test suite is green on the pinned NetBox 4.6.

items.description: Run `python manage.py makemigrations netbox_email --check --dry-run` on an ephemeral NetBox 4.6; confirm the hand-authored 0001_initial matches the models (FK target netbox_services.serviceinstance serializes, the ArrayField destinations column matches, dependencies resolve — virtualization first node is 0001_virtualization).

`python /opt/netbox/app/netbox/manage.py test netbox_email --keepdb -v2` green: models (str, choice colors, uniqueness, array default, cascade), api (CRUD mixins incl. ArrayField round-trip), filtersets.

Confirm `netbox_services.api.serializers.ServiceInstanceSerializer` import path resolves at runtime under the deployed netbox-services wheel; adjust the nested serializer import if the sibling renames it.

phases.title: Deploy + backfill
phases.exit_criteria: Plugin is installed as a wheel on prod + dev NetBox, migrated, granted, and the existing mail infrastructure is represented natively.

items.description: Build + `uv pip install --no-deps --reinstall` the wheel into the NetBox venv (prod pct 74234, dev pct 92254), migrate netbox_email, restart once, and scope an ObjectPermission grant so the new models are not 403 (the netbox-system-services deploy pattern).

Populate MailDomain (+ DKIM selector/key ref), Mailbox, MailAlias, and MailRelay from the real Stalwart/mail deployment (PUB_MAIL VLAN 66), linking each domain/relay to its netbox_services.ServiceInstance where one exists; credential_ref/dkim_key_ref point at OpenBao paths only.

phases.title: Seeder + consumer wiring
phases.exit_criteria: An idempotent seeder loads email intent into NetBox and tofu-stalwart reads it as SoT.

items.description: Idempotent upsert seeder (the netbox-seeder pattern) for MailDomain/Mailbox/MailAlias/MailRelay, credential_ref/dkim_key_ref pointing at OpenBao paths (never secret values).

Wire tofu-stalwart to read the REST contract for domains/mailboxes/aliases/relays, resolving each password/DKIM key from its *_ref OpenBao path at apply time and installing the virtual-alias maps from the destinations arrays.
